Snippet.title: Snippet
Snippet.description: Represents a code snippet stored in the system.

userId.description: Reference to the User who created the snippet.

code.description: The actual code content of the snippet.

language.description: Programming language of the code snippet.

isPublic.description: Indicates whether the snippet is publicly accessible.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the snippet was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the snippet was last updated.

viewCount.description: Number of times the snippet has been viewed.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application. Note: User authentication details are assumed to be managed externally.

definition.description: Stores user profile information. User documents are only accessible by the user themselves.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores all code snippets. Public snippets are readable by anyone, while private snippets are only readable by their owner.

params.name: snippetId
params.description: The unique identifier of the snippet.
